go test -count=1 -overlay $P/overlay.json ./calc > $P/gt.log 2>&1 || { if grep -q '^--- FAIL' $P/gt.log; then awk '/^--- FAIL/{p=1} p' $P/gt.log | grep -vE '^(ok[[:space:]]|PASS$|FAIL$)' | head -200; else tail -60 $P/gt.log; fi; node $P/firstdiff.mjs $P/gt.log; exit 1; }
echo '== names calc/a_examples_test.go'; git show HEAD:calc/a_examples_test.go | grep -oE '^func Test[A-Za-z0-9_]*' | sed -E 's/^func //' | grep -vxF "TestAExample4" | grep -vxF "TestA_old" > $P/names || true; while IFS= read -r n; do grep -qE "^func $n\(" calc/a_examples_test.go || { echo "test removed: $n"; exit 1; }; done < $P/names
echo '== names report/b_test.go'; git show HEAD:report/b_test.go | grep -oE '^func Test[A-Za-z0-9_]*' | sed -E 's/^func //' > $P/names || true; while IFS= read -r n; do grep -qE "^func $n\(" report/b_test.go || { echo "test removed: $n"; exit 1; }; done < $P/names
